summary: The longrun suite is built, runs reliably (about 17 min for 15 in-game days, ~890 TPS), and is committed on int/longrun (00c9851). The last full 15-day run FAILED one check: guests arrived on only 4 of 15 days (needs 5). That one looks like a real balance finding rather than a suite bug (see notes). All other checks passed: ledger sum stays 0, 0 HLog errors, no stuck guests, no module paused, income > 0. Average income was 48.5 silver/day (first 5 days: 83.5), against the KONZEPT D20 target of 60-150/day.
implemented: Source/Hearth/Showcase/ShowcaseBuilder.cs: hotel builder extracted from ShowcaseSuite (site, floors, walls, furniture, power, staff, bank + insurance). ShowcaseSuite now delegates to it; a showcase run still takes all its screenshots.

Source/Hearth/Showcase/LongRunSuite.cs: suite 'longrun' (ExplicitOnly, HH_LONGRUN_DAYS env shortens the run, default 15). Day 0 builds the hotel and forces two guest groups; after that only scheduler arrivals. Samples every 60 ticks, upkeep every 2500 ticks, one row per ledger day.

Daily row: guests present/arrived/left (return visits counted as new stays), nights sold, till and bank balance, total income and income by category (found by reflection on Ledger.daily), renown, whispers, average satisfaction, casino house result, dishes cooked/sold with takings, insurance premiums/claims/benefit, ledger sum, HLog errors/warnings, TPS, pawn and colonist count.

End checks: all days played, ledger sums to 0 at every poll, no new HLog errors, guests arrived on >= 5 days, income > 0, no guest stuck (stay > max(3, planned nights + 1) days, or 'leaving' for > 1 day), no module paused by Guard. Also reachability checks for every hotel area and every kitchen station's interaction cell.

Report: CSV and markdown written next to HH_TEST_OUT as longrun_<label>.csv/.md after every day (a timeout keeps partial data) and finalised in a finally block. The report has the daily table, income-by-category table, balance summary against D20, checks, problems, HLog errors and notes.
tools/longrun/run_longrun.sh runs the suite with TIMEOUT=3000 and copies the report to docs/longrun/longrun.csv and longrun.md (the last full run is committed).

Run setup, all disclosed in the report: all HH_/SL_ and HH_Hospitality/HH_Banking research finished up front; threat incidents zeroed (34 defs, since threatScale 0 alone still let raids and mad animals through); any remaining hostile pawns removed; kitchen bills added (do-until 3 Everyday plates for dishes whose ingredients the pantry restock provides); generators refuelled; pantry restocked when low; starving colonists fed once; heat/cold hediffs reset if severe.
not_done: Insurance claim/benefit flows are logged but only 1 claim appeared in the 15 days, so those paths are barely exercised.
Casino income never shows as a colony income category in the table; only the house result (DayRow.HouseWin) is logged. House accounts do not feed Ledger.DayIncome unless swept to the till.
Dishes cooked is a polled lower bound (plate things on the map, every 120 ticks), because there is no cook counter in the Kitchen module.
Starting threats: the colony begins with Sorne Geneline insects on the map and a raid arrives at tick 325256 in every run. Both are neutralised by the suite, not fixed.

Sonnet/Opus review of the balance numbers is left to the integrator. ShowcaseSuite after the refactor was run once: screenshots OK, only the existing insurance-research FAIL remains. Its station orientation changed (see notes).
tests: tools/longrun/run_longrun.sh run15d (full 15 days, TIMEOUT 3000): RESULT FAIL 36 checks, 1 failure = 'guests arrived on >= 5 days: 4 of 15'. newErrors=0, ledger 0 every day, no stuck guests, no Guard pause.
Short runs (HH_LONGRUN_DAYS=1..3) used while fixing the builder and suite.

tools/showcase/run_showcase.sh sc_lr: 28 checks, 1 failure ('at least one insurance policy signed': showcase never finished the Insurance research), screenshots 01-09 and the rest taken. I did not run the smoke suite.
notes_for_integrator: DAILY NUMBERS (final run, silver; day 0 is the partial build day): income per day 0:505.8 (food 241.8, rooms 210, spa 54; includes the forced groups), 1:210, 2:0, 3:60, 4:15, 5:132.4, 6:155, 7:155, 8-15: 0 for all eight days. Total 1233.2 over 16 ledger days. Average per full day 48.5 (first 5 days 83.5); target D20 early game 60-150/day. Renown 12.3 to 19.4, whispers 0.0 (4.0 in an earlier run), satisfaction 0.26-0.91 (lows on days 7-8), 11 guests seen, 5 return visits, 10 nights sold, 17 plates cooked, 10 sold. Bank balance rises about 15/day from interest (4773 to 5406, with a loan taken at setup). TPS ~890 at maximum speed, 0 errors/warnings. Other full runs gave a similar picture: average 15.1 (colonists died) and 24.3 and 76.7 silver/day.

BALANCE: income is very lumpy. Days 8-15 earn nothing because no group arrived. Cause: MapComponent_HH_GuestScheduler.RatePerDay = 0.6 x RenownCurve(renown ~12-19 = 0.5-0.6) x cap, where cap = min(1, freeBeds/3 + 0.15) + min(0.6, venues x 0.3) = about 1.6, giving about 0.5 groups/day. The hotel has only 3 beds (6 slots as built). Only 3-4 groups arrived in 15 days, which fails the 'arrived on >= 5 days' check. Options: raise the base rate or the early renown curve, or lower the check to 3 days. Per-guest price looks high: a dish sold for about 70 silver (4 dishes = 241.8 on day 0), a room night for 105.

BALANCE: the restaurant earned only on days 0, 3 and 4. After day 5 no more plates were cooked (cooked 0 on most days) because there were never more than 2-3 colonists working at once, and one died on day 6 (plague, then a berserk guest). Guests mostly come in the afternoon, bills only restock to 3 plates, and kitchen stations run through the normal bill system. A shopkeeper-less restaurant therefore depends on the player keeping bills running.

BUG IN CODE I FIXED (ShowcaseBuilder, no action needed): the kitchen stations were spawned Rot4.South, so their InteractionCell was inside the north wall and no cook could ever reach them. The showcase never noticed because it teleports pawns and uses pre-placed plates. They are now Rot4.North; DoughBench moved to (1,7) rot West (its aisle cell is a dining chair, so it is not usable). A merge with i_showcase will touch ShowcaseSuite/ShowcaseBuilder.

FINDING (Wellness): in the first 2-day trial the log showed 'Could not reserve Thing_HH_HotTub... for maxPawns 2' from Hearth.Wellness.JobDriver_UseWellness.TryMakePreToilReservations. A third guest was given HH_UseHotTub while two already held it. Cause: the job is given via JobGuestActivity without checking CanReserve for the tub's 2-pawn capacity, or TryMakePreToilReservations reserves with errorOnFailed=true. Fix: check pawn.CanReserve(tub, 2, 0) before returning the job, and make the pre-toil reservation errorOnFailed:false. It did not recur in the 15-day runs (vanilla Verse error, not an HLog error, so it does not fail the suite).
FINDING (Guests): a returning guest keeps the same PawnId. Without per-stay tracking they looked like 8.6-day stays; the suite now handles this. Guest overstays did not occur otherwise.

FINDING (heat): colonists collapsed from heatstroke inside the unventilated showcase hotel in summer (the builder has no coolers); this killed staff in some runs. The suite resets heat/cold hediffs (0 assists in the final run). If you want a more realistic run, add coolers/heaters to the builder.

Unlike the showcase, the longrun finishes ALL HH_/SL_ research up front (the showcase insurance step fails without it). If you want the showcase to pass, call the same FinishResearch before ShowcaseBuilder.Build.

Merge notes: ShowcaseSuite.cs was heavily restructured (helpers moved to ShowcaseBuilder, delegating properties). If i_showcase changed ShowcaseSuite further, apply those edits to ShowcaseBuilder instead. No module code was touched.
